craft_notes: Sthāyin: immunity-joy (scriptures impotent). Sanskrit first: universal locus + never + rhetorical kim → L4 sets immunity line 1, dismissal line 2. Rows: row 3 (what/do frame). Rupture: colon after low — immunity held, dismissal asked. Close: end-weight on the question (do? — the zero answer). Minimal pass: 'high or low' for sarvāsv avasthāsu (all states sung). Read aloud: never slips — what then? Rejected: 'situations' for avasthā — killed: states kept (avasthā-register); 'bark' for kurvanti — killed: do kept (plain impotence).

lines: Whose self-stand slips in no state, high or low:
what can the scripture-wanderers' stirrings do?
l4.sanskrit_cite: yasya sarvāsv avasthāsu svasthitir naiva lupyate / tasya kiṃ nāma kurvanti śāstrabhramaṇavibhramāḥ

reads_against.argmap: His self-standing never lost in any state — scripture-wanderings do nothing to him.
c1_essence: Self-standing never lost: scripture-squabbles do nothing.
